submission_method.quote: Proponents must submit an electronic copy by email.

contract_term.value: 5-year initial term with options to renew for two separate 3-year renewals, total term up to a maximum of 11 years
contract_term.quote: Olds College will enter a contract for services for five (5) years. There will also be the opportunity to renew the contract for two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, based solely on the College's discretion. The total contract term, if optional renewals are activated, may be up to a maximum of a eleven (11) years period.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Olds College is purchasing a Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support, including modules, content management, assessment, communication, accessibility, mobile access, AI tools, data analytics, integrations, security, implementation, and ongoing support, as detailed in Section D.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: In order for its Proposal to be considered further in the evaluation process the Proponent must respond, in detail, to each of the following requirements, as set out specifically in Section D: Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is scored at 40 points. The evaluation criteria table lists 'Pricing' with a weight of 40 points. The pricing schedule requires submission of 'Implementation Costs' (One-Time Implementation or Enhancement costs) and 'Ongoing LMS Licensing and/or Support Costs' (Annual Software Subscription and/or Ongoing Support Costs). Prices must remain fixed and applicable to all goods and services throughout the entire term of the 5 year agreement. Pricing is submitted in Canadian dollars.

insurance_requirements.quote: Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence against third party claims for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage (including loss of use thereof). ... Insurance on property of others on an "all risks" basis, including theft, and in an amount sufficient to cover such property in the Contractor's care, custody and control.

references_required.quote: Proponents should provide three references, where their company has provided the goods and services similar to those outlined in this RFP

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: RFP Evaluations & product demos September 10 - November 15, 2026

vendor_experience_required.value: no stated minimum years or project count; qualitative requirements include: a brief company history including length of time in business and number of years providing goods/services requested; experience in providing LMS systems and support or support for existing Moodle LMS; experience working with post-secondary institutions previously, including with institutions that utilize Ellucian Banner
vendor_experience_required.quote: a) a brief company history, including the length of time the company has been in business and the number of years providing the goods and services requested in this RFP; ... c) an outline of the Proponent's experience in providing the goods and services set out in this RFP, including providing LMS systems and support; or support for the existing Moodle LMS (if applicable) ... d) the Proponent's experience working with post-secondary institutions previously, including with institutions that utilize Ellucian Banner

value: Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information; Safeguards against data breaches; Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA); Proponents must be able to provide a HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment.

The Contractor and each of its employees and sub-contractors shall keep all sensitive information strictly confidential and shall not disclose or release such information or any portion of it, to any person whatsoever, except to Olds College and except as may be required at law.

The Contractor shall comply with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FOIP Act) pertaining to all information and records relating to, obtained, created, generated, collected, or provided under or pursuant to this Agreement.

The Contractor shall at all times comply with all federal, provincial and municipal laws, including without limitation, laws and regulations pertaining to licensing, public health, human rights, fire safety, employment practices and occupational health and safety.
